name: OpenClaw
description: Personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp and more.
whatItDoes: Gives one person an assistant available in the chat channels they already use, with state, memory and credentials kept on their own hardware. Models and agent harnesses are swappable plugins.
howItWorks: A Gateway process installed as a daemon links chat channels to the configured model or harness. An onboarding wizard checks model access and creates the workspace, and a dashboard command opens the Control UI.

requirements.name: Node.js 24.16+ or 26.1+
requirements.description: Provisioned by the installer when missing

requirements.name: Model access
requirements.description: A model provider or harness verified during onboarding

models: Claude, Codex and local models through plugins
